what: Female reproductive system of cockroach (Fig. 11.15, right column of printed p134): ovary, oviduct, common oviduct or vagina, colleterial glands, genital chamber, vestibulum, gonapophyses, spermatheca

Digestive system of cockroach (Fig. 11.6, bottom right of printed p129): pharynx, salivary gland, salivary reservoir, oesophagus, crop, gizzard, hepatic caeca, mesenteron or midgut, Malpighian tubules, ileum, colon, rectum
